official.deadline_note: The convocatoria states the submission deadline expires on 16 October 2026 and that results will be announced at the end of November.
official.status_note: Applications for the 2027 period are published on the Instituto's own documents page and close on 16 October 2026, six days after this record was verified.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The beca finances the honorarios (fees) of the principal researcher and of the undergraduate research assistant, not tuition; the convocatoria states explicitly that the economic support of S/. 10 000 will finance 'los honorarios del investigador y del asistente de investigacion'.
official.funding_period: total award for the whole grant, up to 10 months
benefits: Individual research scholarship of S/. 10 000 (diez mil soles)
Group research scholarship of S/. 20 000 (veinte mil soles)

Payment in two instalments of 50%: the first after signature of the award contract, the second after the article is published in a Scopus- or Web of Science-indexed journal or in a book with an academic publisher
Amounts paid to members of the PUCP community through the payroll (boleta de remuneraciones); external members are paid via recibo por honorarios
The Instituto may count additional funding from PUCP or external sources, in money or in documentary sources for the research, provided it is mentioned in the project presentation
eligibility: Individual scholarship: ordinary members of the Instituto Riva-Aguero

Individual scholarship: associate members of the Instituto Riva-Aguero who hold a doctorate and are contracted PUCP academic staff with TPA, TPC or TC dedication, and who have taught at least one course with a minimum value of two credits in the last four regular semesters including the semester of this convocatoria (2025-1, 2025-2, 2026-1 and 2026-2)

Individual scholarship: affiliated and honorary members of the Instituto Riva-Aguero who hold a doctorate and belong to a research group, with no academic activity, article or research pending delivery to the Instituto at the time of application
Group scholarship: all study and research groups registered and approved by the Instituto's council up to the closing date of the convocatoria
Both modalities require an undergraduate student of the Pontificia Universidad Catolica del Peru as project assistant
requirements: Projects must fall within one of the Instituto's five research lines

Winners undertake to sign the agreements established with the Instituto Riva-Aguero, including the obligation to publish results in a Scopus- or Web of Science-indexed journal or in a book with an academic publisher, with explicit affiliation to the Instituto Riva-Aguero in that publication
A progress report must be submitted three months after the project starts, with a maximum date of 31 January 2027
The article for publication in the indexed journal must be delivered by 31 December 2027 at the latest
Non-compliance with the progress report obliges the recipient to return the first payment transferred and bars them from future Instituto convocatorias, individually or in groups

The Instituto retains for two years, from delivery of the publishable document, the right to publish the research; after that period the author may publish freely, stating that the research was funded by the Instituto Riva-Aguero
documents: Research project following the specified format: titulo, fundamentacion del tema propuesto, estado de la cuestion, hipotesis, objetivos, metodologia, esquema de la investigacion, cronograma de actividades, bibliografia, presupuesto, and a brief updated CV of all project participants
Completed online form for the individual scholarship (linked from the convocatoria) or the group scholarship (linked from the convocatoria)
Mention of any additional funding source, from PUCP or external, which may be in money or in documentary sources for the research
selection_criteria: Projects must fall within one of the Instituto's research lines: Historia del Peru e historia transatlantica siglos XVI-XXI; Estado, politica, procesos y actores sociales, siglos XVI-XXI; Literatura, arte, cine y otras practicas culturales; Patrimonio material e inmaterial; Filosofia, ciencia y educacion en el Peru, siglos XVI-XXI
Selection is made by a committee made up of the Instituto's director or research coordinator, a representative of PUCP's Vicerrectorado de Investigacion, and a member of the Instituto Riva-Aguero
The selection committee may call on other members of the Instituto's Consejo Directivo and on national and international experts in the fields covered
coverage: Individual scholarship: honorarios of the researcher and of the research assistant, S/. 10 000 in two 50% instalments
Group scholarship: S/. 20 000, 50% after signature of the contract and 50% after publication of the results
Both entries are subject to pension contributions and the 5th category income tax, so the net amount received is lower than the gross award
application_method: Check whether you qualify as an ordinary, associate, affiliated or honorary member of the Instituto, or whether your group is registered and approved by the Instituto's council
Confirm your project fits one of the five Instituto research lines before drafting
Prepare the project in the specified format, including the presupuesto and the updated CVs of all participants
Find a PUCP undergraduate student to act as project assistant, since this is an indispensable requirement in both modalities
Complete the online form for your modality and submit before 16 October 2026
official.application_route: Submit the project through the online form published in the convocatoria: one form for the individual scholarship and another for the group scholarship. Contact for inquiries is evelyn.sotomayor@pucp.pe.
official.citizenship_residency: No nationality or residency requirement is published; eligibility is based on membership status of the Instituto Riva-Aguero and, for associates, on contracted PUCP teaching appointment.
official.international_eligibility: Open to external members of the PUCP community, who are paid via recibo por honorarios rather than through the payroll; no separate international eligibility rule is published.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Projects must inscribe within one of the Instituto Riva-Aguero's research lines: history of Peru and transatlantic history, state and social processes, literature, art, film and cultural practices, material and intangible heritage, or philosophy, science and education.
official.research_requirement: An original research project led by a principal investigator who is responsible as director of their own project (individual) or by the respective group coordinator who is responsible for signing the funding contracts and administering the awarded funds (group).
official.duration: Maximum ten months, established between 2 November 2026 and 3 September 2027
official.description: The Direccion of the Instituto Riva-Aguero of the Pontificia Universidad Catolica del Peru announces its research scholarship convocatoria for the 2027 period: an individual research scholarship of S/. 10 000 and a group research scholarship of S/. 20 000, each lasting a maximum of ten months established between 2 November 2026 and 3 September 2027. Projects must be presented under the convocatoria's stated conditions, must inscribe within one of the Instituto's research lines, and winners must sign agreements with the Instituto, including the obligation to publish their results in a Scopus- or Web of Science-indexed journal or in a book with an academic publisher, with explicit affiliation to the Instituto Riva-Aguero.
official.program_type: University institute research grant administered by IDEA PUCP, open to members of the Instituto Riva-Aguero

not_confirmed: living_cost_coverage: the convocatoria states the money finances honorarios of the researcher and the assistant, and does not describe it as covering living costs, so this field is left null rather than asserted either way

travel_coverage: the convocatoria's line 'Actividades de investigacion y publicacion' was described on the Instituto's own publications page as covering activities far beyond a traditional research grant, including travel, but no travel item is stated in the published convocatoria, so this field is left null
study_mode: not stated in the convocatoria
Whether a spousal or other donor-honorarios form is required for PUCP community members, as the convocatoria refers to the payroll route but does not list the form
The convocatoria's own text is a scanned-style PDF whose extraction contained a garbled fragment, so any wording quoted in this record is limited to sentences extracted cleanly
verification.notes: Confirmed against the Instituto Riva-Aguero's own convocatoria PDF, which is indexed on the Instituto's official documents page as 'BASES | Convocatoria Becas IRA individual y grupal 2027' and which the Instituto's site dates to August 2026. All amounts, dates and conditions in this record were extracted from that PDF on 10 October 2026, so this is a live verification from the awarding body's own document rather than a description of it.

applicant_utility.summary: At S/. 10 000 for an individual project and S/. 20 000 for a group, this is a competitive internal grant at PUCP, and the gatekeeping is membership of the Instituto Riva-Aguero, so an outside applicant cannot simply apply. The money pays honorarios, that is, fees for the researcher and for a mandatory PUCP undergraduate assistant, and it arrives in two halves: the first only after the award contract is signed, the second only once the research is published in a Scopus or Web of Science journal, or in a book with an academic publisher, carrying an explicit Riva-Aguero affiliation. Be aware that PUCP members receive the amount through the payroll, which means pension contributions and fifth-category income tax are deducted, so the net figure in your hand will be materially below the headline number. The window closes on 16 October 2026 with results at the end of November, which is an unusually fast turnaround.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Ordinary members of the Instituto Riva-Aguero, and associate or affiliated members holding a doctorate with a contracted PUCP teaching position, as well as registered and council-approved Instituto research groups, working within the Instituto's five research lines.
application_readiness_checklist: Verify your Instituto membership category (ordinario, asociado, afiliado, honorario) and that your group is registered and approved by the Instituto's council
If you are an associate member, count your taught courses: at least one course worth a minimum of two credits in each of the last four regular semesters 2025-1, 2025-2, 2026-1 and 2026-2
If you are an affiliated or honorary member, check you have no academic activity, article or research pending delivery to the Instituto
Recruit a PUCP undergraduate student as project assistant before you write the project, since this is indispensable in both modalities
Frame the project inside one of the five Instituto research lines and state it clearly
Build the presupuesto into the project document, along with the brief updated CVs of all participants
Complete the modality-specific online form and submit before 16 October 2026
common_rejection_risks: Not being an Instituto member, or having an unregistered research group, since the convocatoria is closed to them
Failing to commit a PUCP undergraduate assistant to the project
A project that does not inscribe within one of the five research lines

Missing the instalment conditions: the second 50% depends on publication in an indexed journal or academic book, so a project longer than the 31 December 2027 article deadline risks losing half the money
Forgetting that the Instituto retains the right to publish the research for two years
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Salary, living expenses and anything outside the researchers' honorarios. The convocatoria also warns that amounts paid to PUCP community members are remuneration subject to pension contributions and fifth-category income tax, so the net amount is lower than the gross award.
document_audit: The convocatoria specifies an exact project format including the bibliografia, cronograma and presupuesto; an application missing any of these elements is incomplete on its face
Brief updated CVs of all participants are part of the required package, not an optional attachment
alerts: The Instituto may revoke any decision it has made as guarantor, declaring the assignment null and void, and it does not accept any responsibility for decisions incorrectly taken

There is a separate track: the winner may not publish other works in the period covered by this call, since the Instituto retains publication rights for two years from delivery of the publishable document
Results are announced at the end of November 2026, with the project running from 2 November 2026 to 3 September 2027
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Online form published in the convocatoria, one for the individual scholarship and one for the group scholarship, with the project document in the specified format attached; queries to evelyn.sotomayor@pucp.pe.
